verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm user-level notification rules: readiness reports check 'optimal notification rule configurations', and the REST API configures 'how they're notified'. The mobile app delivers pages. Community users independently confirm push, SMS and phone-call delivery, with app-first-then-call escalation timing. Missing for 10: first-party documentation enumerating push/SMS/phone/email channels and per-channel rule configuration (delays, ordering, urgency), and any evidence of email as an outbound paging channel.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules
